# Gold (XAU/USD) briefing — None SGT

Price is $4367.6, -32.1 (-0.73%) compared with yesterday's close of 4399.7.
Current read: BEARISH. Gold is being pushed DOWN right now. Because it's -0.73% compared with where it finished yesterday, and in the last hour it's been going up (+0.01%), and today's headlines lean bad for gold (8 bad vs 2 good).
Today's range: low $4284.3 to high $4398.2. Price is 73% of the way up that range ($83.3 above the low, $30.6 below the high).
Trading sessions open right now: London. Next: US data drop (8:30am ET) in 37 minutes.
Measured from the last two days of 1-minute data, gold moves most in these hours (SGT): 20:00 (4.4 pips/min), 21:00 (4.3 pips/min), 22:00 (3.5 pips/min).
Related markets today: US dollar index 100.503 (+0.25%), US 10-year yield 4.976 (+0.59%), Silver 67.14 (+1.58%).
The US dollar is stronger today (+0.25%), and gold is down (-0.73%). That is the normal relationship: they usually move opposite ways, so the dollar is a good explanation for gold today.

Things that do not line up (these are usually the real story):
